review_issue_summaries.summary: Album, artist and clickable-metadata form an import cycle through a utils helper that imports screens
music_player_runtime and music_player_service import each other, with the service re-exporting the runtime
utils, widgets and player components import screen files, inverting the layer direction
services/ is a 41-file catch-all that also owns glass rendering and UI navigation state
utils, models, theme and services import screens, widgets and providers, inverting the layer order
screens/library/ holds the Library section QueueTab, which reads as the player queue
controllers/, routes/ and constants/ are one- or two-file top-level folders beside providers/
Songs/Playlists tab keeps its own selection state instead of using SelectionModeMixin used by sibling screens
Shared widgets use both app_ and sistrum_ prefixes with no rule for choosing one
LogScreen is the only *Screen subpage in settings/, where every other subpage is *Page
Large files split with Dart part files in some areas but with separate library modules in services/library
ApkDownloader.downloadApk returns null for SHA mismatch, invalid payload and network errors alike
ApkDownloader.installApk logs and swallows installer failures, so the caller cannot react
Backup archive parsing returns null for corrupt, unsupported and I/O failures alike
Services signal failure through null, bool, void and exceptions with no common convention
QueueTab and queue_tab_* files name the Library browser, not the playback queue
LibraryTracksFolderScreen uses 'folder' for Loved and playlist track lists
State class named __AnimatedLibrarySliverGridState with a doubled underscore
_GroupedLocalAlbum.searchKey is set but never read, and its name refers to removed search
AutoMix and Autoplay helpers take the whole MusicPlayerHandler and reach into its privates
music_player_runtime.dart and music_player_service.dart import each other
utils/clickable_metadata.dart imports screens that import it back
_loadIndex is a 160-line function with repeated cancellation guards and hand-copied SAF lease cleanup
Cover directory cleanup nests a second silent try/catch around a helper that already swallows errors
Library DB rows decoded at ~20 sites in two shapes (bare and {source,item} envelope)
Same database reached via runtime dependency in one provider and singleton elsewhere
Song menu lookup maps every exception to a file-not-found message
Player collection lookup silently fabricates a Track when the library match fails
Three artist paging loops repeat dedupe and cursor logic with inconsistent end detection
Mutable priority map held in a Provider and mutated by a consumer
Play-count key translation inlined in the artist ranking loop
Widget tests wait on wall-clock DateTime deadlines and real event-loop delays, making them timing-sensitive
sistrum_icons.dart is imported by 8 lib files but has no direct test
Shared player slider and content card widgets have no direct tests despite multiple importers
The main shell route (tabs, bar and chrome host) has no direct test reference
deleteByPath returns void while deleteByPaths returns a deleted count
Queue paging methods return a mix of records, pages and bare lists
Two snapshot writers share a stem but differ in inputs, mechanism and output
Five near-identical try/catch wrappers for scan notifications in local_library_provider.dart
Best-effort file delete try/catch(_) idiom is copied inline across many services without a shared helper
Production collection readers take a test-only forceLegacy flag and choose a Dart path by row-count probe.
Android-only app keeps Dart fallback branches gated by supportsCoreBackend for backup encode/parse and collections.
lib/widgets/ has about 65 top-level files spanning many unrelated concerns
Library, playback and glass services sit at lib/services/ root beside their existing subpackages
lib/utils imports screens and widgets, inverting the layer direction
Service files import providers and widgets, so the service layer depends on UI
unified_library_item model imports the library database models from services
lib/screens/library/ holds only queue tab files while library section screens sit at screens root
CoverPalette exposes a mutable static store and static caches that tests must swap and clear by hand
PlatformBridge keeps class-level event stream, handler-installed flag and job map with no explicit lifecycle
